Game Overview

Pumpkin Knife is a arcade title where embark on a knife-throwing adventure with Pumpkin Knife. Test your precision and strategy as you launch knives at a spinning pumpkin. Master timing and unlock new challenges, all while racing against escalating difficulty. Perfect for quick sessions or becoming a master of aim in this addictive test of skill!
